reason: The app's eps=7.41 is exactly the company's own reported FY2025-26 consolidated Basic & Diluted EPS (standalone 7.49), computed on the weighted-average share count (about 1.23 crore shares, because the IPO shares listed on 3 Oct 2025, partway through the year). screener's 6.50 divides net profit by the year-end count of about 1.414 crore shares. That is a definitional difference (weighted-average vs period-end shares), not a wrong value, and the spec rules that such differences are never called wrong. The 'internal inconsistency' (net_income_ttm/shares_outstanding=6.43) is the same definitional gap. P/E 4.73 is price over the reported EPS, a legitimate basis. The pack witness itself (standalone 9.2 Cr vs the app's consolidated 9.098 Cr) confirms the app is on the reported consolidated basis.

reason: Real but overstated. The world value is determinable: the FY26 annual report says the Board 'have not recommended any dividend'. But the null is NOT a silent or unlabeled blank. yfinance_provider stamps field_meta status=unavailable with reason 'provider did not publish this field', and the Equity Overview cell renders it as an explicit 'not published' chip. dividend_per_share_ttm is a derived field that the research leg affirms as zero only when history depth reaches 12 months, and CHTR listed 3 Oct 2025 (under 12 months as of the 19-Sep snapshot). reason: The value gap is real: the annual report states 'The Company does not have any borrowings', so D/E=0 is knowable, yet the app serves null because yfinance's info omits debtToEquity. The mechanism is corrected: it is a labelled gap ('not published' chip, field_meta reason), not a silent blank. The balance-sheet route cannot supply the value either, because of DAT-P3-1.

reason: The mechanism is real: get_results_calendar is NSE-only (nse_provider), and the route turns the ProviderError into a 502 for any BSE-only symbol. The impact is narrower than claimed. No frontend code calls /disclosures/results. Its only in-product consumer is the research disclosures leg, which calls it only for earnings-date questions and soft-fails to {ok:false} without raising, while BSE announcements (which include board-meeting outcomes and intimations) are still served in the same leg. So the 502 never reaches a user surface, and the results-calendar gap for BSE-only names is low severity.
evidence_checked: Opened the route, the service and the only consumer; grepped src/ and plugins/ for any caller of /disclosures/results (none); re-ran the repro live against :52152.
